# Through bore in a filleted I-beam flange

Reduced from `i_beam_008928_s20260505` in [BenchCAD](https://huggingface.co/datasets/BenchCAD/BenchCAD)
`code_gen` at revision `5919f578ab09ec283603a082fab07c7639ab56eb`
([CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)).
One bore reproduces the face-arrangement error with the chamfer removed.
The boring cylinder cuts through the flange and the web and leaves one
connected solid. The recorded CadQuery 2.3.0 and Open CASCADE 7.9.3.0
run for this reduction confirms the desired outcome. The unbored beam
and the bore on the unfilleted beam both build in arris 0.12.0.
